title: Knowing what to do with your hands in photos is always a point of con...
description: Knowing what to do with your hands in photos is always a point of contention. Sometimes it’s not always about the photo when it comes to taking better photos, it’s WHAT you do in the photos! So on today’s episode of Boyfriend Bootcamp, we’re hopping on the other side and breaking down our most asked question “How to pose.” Hope this helps, let us know what you want us to cover next, and we’ll catch you back here in a couple days for the next episode!
